subject: Fail to run multi-byte app on ShinyApps Server

messages.subject: Fail to run multi-byte app on ShinyApps Server
parts:
Hi:

I can run a multi-byte app at local PC using runApp(),
and successfully deploy this app using deployApp().

This app loads a multi-byte Traditional Chinese table,
does some processing, then shows the barplot.

But when it comes to ShinyApps server,
the following error message shows:

 https://tommysheu.shinyapps.io/shinyapp2/

Error in type.convert(data[[i]], as.is = as.is[i], dec = dec, na.strings = character(0L)) : invalid multibyte string at '<a6>n' Calls: runApp ... eval -> eval -> read.csv -> read.table -> type.convert Execution halted

Even I set the locale to "Chinese_Taiwan.950", it still doesn't work.

Will it be a problem to run non-English apps on the ShinyApps Server?
Attached are the related files.

regards,
tommy
